description: This file defines a generic base repository class using SQLAlchemy for CRUD operations on ORM models, providing methods for get, get_all, create, update, and delete.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: A generic base repository class that provides CRUD operations for SQLAlchemy models.

methods.name: __init__(self, model)
methods.description: Initializes the repository with a specific SQLAlchemy model.

methods.name: get(self, db: Session, obj_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieve a single object by its primary key.

methods.name: get_all(self, db: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
methods.description: Retrieve all objects with optional pagination (skip and limit).

methods.name: create(self, db: Session, obj_in: dict)
methods.description: Create a new database object from a dictionary of fields.

methods.name: update(self, db: Session, db_obj, obj_in: dict)
methods.description: Update fields of a database object with new values and save changes.

ctags.name: create
ctags.pattern: /^    def create(self, db: Session, obj_in: dict):$/

ctags.name: get
ctags.pattern: /^    def get(self, db: Session, obj_id: int):$/

ctags.name: get_all
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_all(self, db: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100):$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)

ctags.name: update
ctags.pattern: /^    def update(self, db: Session, db_obj, obj_in: dict):$/
